npcs.name: Dr. Graddius Stoutbrand
npcs.note: Duty-bound to contain the crisis; not fully versed in the facility’s guts, but brings resources and expects the courier job done fast.

enemies.name: Mutated Jamison
enemies.note: Hunts from ceilings; vulnerable to heat/acid; antidote only when unconscious.

enemies.name: Valeria (Ghast)
enemies.note: Will attack if not cured; becomes ally when cured.

locations.name: Nexus Laboratory
locations.detail: Remote arctic dome with sealed wards; alarm locks doors and kills lights.

locations.name: Experimentation Chamber
locations.detail: Broken pod, gas/ammonia on floor; Valeria is here, turned Ghast.
